name: command
useFor: Use for a command menu (open it with Cmd K through CommandDialog) and for searchable lists of sites, layers and pages. Give items a 16px Phosphor glyph and a shortcut where there is one. The list fades at an edge (fade-y) where more items scroll past it.
constraints: An open or close animation on the command dialog
source: Not in Figma. Drawn in Mireye's grammar: the review build's combobox (Bone cut frame, Fog highlight)
title: Command
description: A Bone panel with the 8px cut corner and a 1px Stone line: a 44px search row over the Mist rule, groups headed in the secondary ink and square 32px rows with Fog under the selection.
